correctness.rationale: The order-two de Bruijn graph identifies cyclic three-gram profiles with balanced connected directed Eulerian edge multisets. Balance gives a=x000, h=x111, p=x001=x100, q=x011=x110, r=x010, s=x101=r+q-p >=0 and length n=a+h+p+3q+2r. Five disjoint connectivity cases (p,q positive; p positive q zero; q positive p zero; p=q zero r positive; only one constant loop) produce respectively z⁴(1+z³)/[(1-z⁴)(1-z³)(1-z²)(1-z)²], 2z³/[(1-z³)(1-z²)(1-z)], z²/(1-z²), 2z/(1-z). Their sum is exact for every n, has period dividing 12 and n⁴/288 leading term. Independently enumerated cyclic-word profiles through n=13 and compared coefficients; unrestricted proof is flow/Eulerian connectedness.
residual_risks: Finite computations do not replace the proof.
